name: persistent-worker-runtime
description: Use the persistent-worker-runtime library to offload CPU-bound work to persistent Node.js worker threads while keeping the Event Loop responsive. Covers pool setup, request-response vs outbox modes, L1 state, cancellation, priority routing, zero-copy transfer, retries, preemption, and inter-worker BroadcastChannel for L1 cache invalidation.
author: Felipe Miiller
triggers: execute a task on a worker
